aiSettings.title: AI assistant
aiSettings.lead: Optional "Explain with AI" on pods and Warning events, using your own model endpoint. Off by default. Each request sends a redacted snapshot (events, container status, a short log tail; never Secret or ConfigMap values or env values) to the endpoint below and is audited as <mono>ai.explain</mono> (target only). The base URL is an outbound destination chosen by an admin.
aiSettings.enableHint: When off, the buttons are hidden and the API refuses requests.
aiSettings.apiKeySet: API key (set — leave blank to keep)
aiSettings.mask: Also mask IP addresses and hostnames
aiSettings.maskHint: Recommended. Secrets, tokens and env values are always removed.
aiSettings.agentAutoRunsHint: When on, Warning/CrashLoop signals create ProposeOnly agent runs for approval.
aiSettings.mcpHint: MCP at <mono>/api/v1/mcp</mono> — JSON-RPC tools for cluster investigation and create_agent_run.

invoice.explainer: Allocated is today's monthly run-rate prorated to the days covered, not a historical record. Unallocated is everything else on the bill: idle capacity, other services and accounts outside this cluster. Refreshed at most hourly.

settings.title: Cloud bill reconciliation
settings.lead: Compare the cluster's allocated cost with the actual cloud invoice for this and last month. Experimental: the AWS, Azure and Google Cloud clients have only been tested against recorded fixtures, not real accounts, so check the numbers against your invoice. Credentials are stored in the integrations Secret and never shown again.
settings.permissions: Use read-only credentials: AWS ce:GetCostAndUsage; Azure Cost Management Reader on the subscription; GCP BigQuery Job User plus Data Viewer on the export dataset.
